why: Take 2 has the most life: Zhou won't touch the envelope until the job is said aloud, then reads the terms back. That read-back makes the place and the wait plain.
changes: Renamed the speakers to the scene's names, Zhou and Fixer, to pass the check. No line changed from the last version.
Kept from the last version: Fixer's second line now answers the old lie and names the lean month, replacing the talk of short wages.
Kept from the last version: Zhou's trip-sheet line now says plainly that the Councillor goes home at the chime, and the wait terms sit in one line with the east yard.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: Not on the Councillor's bonnet. Last envelope said "nothing much", and lied.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: This one won't. We hear it's been a lean month.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: It has. What for? I drive the Councillor home at the chime.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Not tonight. Take him round to the service bay, and wait.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: East yard. This buys a couple of minutes, then I drive on.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: That'll do nicely. We'll have him out of that back seat.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: Not in front of me. Anyone watching this bay, I'll send off.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: The envelope's yours, then. You haven't asked who we are.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: Can't repeat what I don't know. Chime, service bay, couple of minutes.

learned: Zhou's paid: Vale's car waits briefly.
